{
 "id": "najdi-crenel-stack",
 "name": "Plaster Cut Row",
 "idea": "A wide matte plaster surface with fine grain sits almost untouched, crossed low by one thin row of small equal triangle cuts that light up in the accent left to right in short stepped beats, hold, then fade together and start again.",
 "use": [
  "hero",
  "header",
  "loading",
  "onboarding-slide"
 ],
 "frag": "precision highp float;\nuniform vec2 u_resolution;\nuniform float u_time;\nuniform vec3 u_c0;\nuniform vec3 u_c1;\nuniform vec3 u_c2;\nuniform vec3 u_c3;\nfloat h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);}\nfloat n(vec2 p){vec2 i=floor(p),f=fract(p);f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);return mix(mix(h(i),h(i+vec2(1.0,0.0)),f.x),mix(h(i+vec2(0.0,1.0)),h(i+vec2(1.0,1.0)),f.x),f.y);}\nfloat tri(vec2 p,float r){const float k=1.7320508;p.x=abs(p.x)-r;p.y=p.y+r/k;if(p.x+k*p.y>0.0)p=vec2(p.x-k*p.y,-k*p.x-p.y)/2.0;p.x-=clamp(p.x,-2.0*r,0.0);return -length(p)*sign(p.y);}\nvoid main(){\nvec2 r=u_resolution;vec2 p=(gl_FragCoord.xy-0.5*r)/r.y;float px=1.5/r.y;float t=u_time;\nfloat a=r.x/r.y;\nfloat m=n(p*2.5+vec2(t*0.015,0.0))*0.6+n(p*6.0-vec2(0.0,t*0.01))*0.4;\nvec3 col=mix(u_c0,u_c3,0.07*m)*(0.97+0.05*m);\nfloat yc=-0.3;\ncol=mix(col,col*0.95,smoothstep(px,-px,p.y-(yc-0.03)));\nfloat P=0.032;\nfloat N=floor(a/P);\nfloat off=(a-N*P)*0.5;\nfloat x=p.x+0.5*a-off;\nfloat ci=floor(x/P);\nfloat inr=step(0.0,ci)*step(ci,N-1.0);\nvec2 q=vec2((fract(x/P)-0.5)*P,p.y-yc);\nfloat cut=smoothstep(px,-px,tri(q,0.0085))*inr;\nfloat ph=fract(t/14.0);\nfloat k=clamp(ph/0.7,0.0,1.0)*8.0;\nfloat s=(floor(k)+smoothstep(0.0,0.35,fract(k)))/8.0;\nfloat fade=1.0-smoothstep(0.9,1.0,ph);\nfloat on=clamp(s*N-ci,0.0,1.0)*fade;\nvec3 imp=mix(col,u_c1,0.07);\nvec3 lit=mix(u_c2,u_c1,0.06);\ncol=mix(col,mix(imp,lit,on),cut);\ncol+=(h(floor(gl_FragCoord.xy))-0.5)*0.03;\ngl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0);}\n",
 "colors": [
  "#3b2a1e",
  "#f3ebdd",
  "#a8432f",
  "#b98a5e"
 ],
 "reduced": {
  "kind": "fade",
  "at": 10,
  "ms": 400,
  "note": "The plain plaster surface fades in with the full row of triangle cuts lit in the accent."
 },
 "cardIds": [
  "najdi-mud-architecture"
 ],
 "lensIds": [
  "najdi"
 ],
 "culturalNotes": "Follows Najdi architecture, the mud-brick earth building tradition of the builders and families of Najd in central Arabia. It borrows only the grammar: a large plain mass that stays far bigger than the pattern, and one strict row of small equal triangle cuts set at a true repeat so each cut lands on the same step. The stepped reveal borrows the lens verb, stack up, as a rhythm, not as a picture of building. It draws no wall, roofline, door or real building. At-Turaif District in ad-Dir'iyah is inscribed by UNESCO as a World Heritage site, and this shader is not endorsed by the site.",
 "styles": [
  "gulf-arabic-first"
 ]
}

{
  "id": "bauhaus-grid-snap",
  "name": "Uneven Grid Snap",
  "idea": "On one flat primary blue ground, a faint grid of uneven spans in the top right holds one large black plane, one black rule and a tight cluster of four red squares, and each piece holds still for a long beat and then snaps one grid step with a short, crisp stop.",
  "use": [
    "hero",
    "empty-state",
    "onboarding-slide"
  ],
  "frag": "precision highp float;\nuniform vec2 u_resolution;\nuniform float u_time;\nuniform vec3 u_c0;\nuniform vec3 u_c1;\nuniform vec3 u_c2;\nuniform vec3 u_c3;\nfloat sn(float t,float T,float o){float f=fract(t/T+o);float d=0.35/T;float a=clamp((f-0.5)/d,0.0,1.0);float b=clamp((f-1.0+d)/d,0.0,1.0);a=1.0-a;a=1.0-a*a*a*a;b=1.0-b;b=1.0-b*b*b*b;return a-b;}\nfloat box(vec2 p,vec2 b){vec2 d=abs(p)-b;return length(max(d,0.0))+min(max(d.x,d.y),0.0);}\nfloat fl(float d,float aa){return 1.0-smoothstep(-0.5*aa,0.5*aa,d);}\nfloat ln(float d,float aa){return 1.0-smoothstep(0.0,0.7*aa,d);}\nvoid main(){\nvec2 r=u_resolution;\nfloat w=min(r.x/r.y,0.72);\nvec2 u=(gl_FragCoord.xy-r)/(r.y*w);\nfloat aa=1.5/(r.y*w);\nfloat t=u_time;\nvec3 col=u_c0;\nfloat gx=min(min(abs(u.x+0.06),abs(u.x+0.24)),min(min(abs(u.x+0.36),abs(u.x+0.48)),abs(u.x+0.94)));\nfloat gy=min(min(abs(u.y+0.06),abs(u.y+0.18)),min(min(abs(u.y+0.42),abs(u.y+0.54)),abs(u.y+0.94)));\nfloat g=max(ln(gx,aa)*step(-1.0,u.y),ln(gy,aa)*step(-1.0,u.x));\ncol=mix(col,u_c3,0.12*g);\nfloat xr=mix(-0.48,-0.36,sn(t,16.0,0.05));\ncol=mix(col,u_c1,fl(box(u-vec2(0.5*(xr-0.94),-0.68),vec2(0.5*(xr+0.94),0.26)),aa));\nfloat yb=mix(-0.54,-0.94,sn(t,13.0,0.3));\ncol=mix(col,u_c1,fl(box(u-vec2(-0.24,0.5*(yb-0.06)),vec2(0.011,0.5*(-0.06-yb))),aa));\nvec2 c=vec2(-0.15,mix(-0.12,-0.30,sn(t,10.0,0.0)));\ncol=mix(col,u_c2,fl(box(abs(u-c)-vec2(0.027),vec2(0.022)),aa));\ngl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0);\n}",
  "colors": [
    "#1f4fa3",
    "#1a1a1a",
    "#d6402b",
    "#f2efe6"
  ],
  "reduced": {
    "kind": "fade",
    "at": 8,
    "ms": 400,
    "note": "The settled grid on the blue ground: the wide black plane, the long black rule and the red cluster at rest in its lower row, top right."
  },
  "cardIds": [
    "bauhaus-1923"
  ],
  "lensIds": [
    "bauhaus"
  ],
  "culturalNotes": "Follows the Bauhaus, the German school of art and design that ran from 1919 to 1933 in Weimar, Dessau and Berlin, founded by Walter Gropius, and credits the many teachers and students of its shared workshops. It borrows the layout grammar only. A strict modular grid with visibly uneven spans stays honest as faint guide lines. One large flat plane sits against a tight cluster of small squares for clear scale contrast, and a single thick black rule works as structure. The composition is asymmetric, and color stays flat and limited to a primary ground, black and one primary accent, with no gradients or shadows. It copies no specific poster, product or artwork.",
  "styles": [
    "flat-color-field"
  ]
}
